role_summary: Senior tax associate covering sales tax, reporting to the Director.

capability_areas.name: Multi-state sales tax
capability_areas.description: Owns end-to-end sales tax filings across twelve production LLCs. Director steps in only on edge cases.

depth_distinction.builder_definition: Owns the twelve-LLC sales tax filing process end-to-end.
depth_distinction.user_definition: Operates the existing twelve-LLC process; escalates only on new-state additions and sourcing-rule changes.
depth_distinction.edge_case_guidance: Numerical anomalies stay in-role; only new-state-or-sourcing-rule events escalate to the Director.
